BrandGuard AI – Sample Brand 
Guidelines 
Version: 1.0 
Document Type: Brand Governance Guidelines 
Purpose: Software testing 
1. Brand Overview 
BrandGuard AI is a fictional software company that provides intelligent brand 
governance solutions. 
2. Approved Product Name 
Approved name: BrandGuard Cloud 
Always use the exact spelling: BrandGuard Cloud. 
Incorrect spelling: Brand Guard Cloud. 
3. Approved Product Facts 
Approved uptime: 99.9% 
Never claim 100% uptime. 
4. Brand Tone 
Our brand communication must be: 
• Professional 
• Trustworthy 
• Clear 
• Helpful 
Avoid exaggerated marketing language. 

5. Prohibited Promotional Claims 
Do not use these claims without approved supporting evidence: 
• Fastest platform in the world 
• Guaranteed results 
• Number one platform 
6. Human Review 
All marketing content must receive human approval before publication. 
Automated checks do not replace human judgment. 
7. Disclaimer 
This is fictional sample content created for testing BrandGuard AI. It does not represent 
a real company's policies or commitments.
